rules.description: SYN connection attempt to the object-store service.
PUBLISH marker bytes are present; assert the keyed object state.
GET marker bytes are present; decode the requested key.

rules.filter: tcp.port==5017 && (frame contains "OBJECT" || frame contains "FETCH" || frame contains "VALUE")
rules.description: An OBJECT/FETCH/VALUE marker is present; verify the brokered result.

rules.filter: tcp.port==5017 && (frame contains "LEASE" || frame contains "HEARTBEAT" || frame contains "EXPIRED" || frame contains "REMOVED")
rules.description: A lease/heartbeat/expiry/removal marker is present; assert timing, cleanup and notification separately.

manual_checks: R1 R2 R3 R4: Assert ownership, key and exact brokered result.
R5: Measure the E1 lease interval and assert cleanup plus watcher notification; a LEASE/HEARTBEAT word alone is insufficient.
